---
title: "Formula sheet"
---

The main results of each module, with links to their derivations. Each result holds only under its
module's assumptions; read those before using it. Every formula here is checked by a test in
`tests/`.

## m03 · Unipolar, bipolar and omnipolar electrograms

Symbols: $\sigma$ conductivity, $i_m$ membrane current per area, $V_m$ transmembrane voltage,
$h$ electrode height, $w$ front width, $c$ conduction velocity, $d$ spacing, $\theta$ angle between
bipole and propagation, $k$ spatial frequency, $r_e$ electrode radius, $s$ distance from the front.
Model: a thin tissue sheet in an infinite homogeneous conductor and a planar front.

**Unipolar potential, thin sheet in an infinite homogeneous conductor** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-volume-conductor))

$$
\phi(\mathbf r, t) = \frac{1}{4\pi\sigma} \iint \frac{i_m(\mathbf r', t)}{\lVert \mathbf r - \mathbf r' \rVert}\, dA'
$$

**Membrane current from the voltage profile** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-cable))

$$
i_m = \beta\,\frac{\partial^2 V_m}{\partial x^2}
$$

**Height filter** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-height-filter))

$$
\hat\phi(k) = \frac{e^{-|k| h}}{2\sigma |k|}\, \hat i_m(k)
$$

**Unipolar electrogram for a planar arctangent front** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-unipolar-closed))

$$
U(s) = A\,\frac{s}{s^2 + a^2},
\qquad
A = \frac{\beta\,\Delta V}{2\pi\sigma},
\qquad
a = w + h
$$

**Unipolar slope** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-unipolar-slope))

$$
\frac{dU}{dt} = -c\,\frac{dU}{ds}
$$

**Bipolar electrogram (distal minus proximal)** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar))

$$
V_{\text{bip}}(t) = \phi(\mathbf r_1, t) - \phi(\mathbf r_2, t),
\qquad
\mathbf r_{1,2} = \mathbf r_0 \pm \tfrac{d}{2}\,\hat u
$$

**Close bipole** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar-gradient))

$$
V_{\text{bip}} \approx d\, \hat u \cdot \nabla \phi = d \cos\theta\, \frac{dU}{ds}
$$

**Disk electrode average** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-disk-average))

$$
H_{\text{disk}}(k) = \frac{2 J_1(k r_e)}{k r_e}
$$

**Bipole transfer function** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-bipolar-transfer))

$$
H_{\text{bip}}(k) = 2i \sin\!\left( \frac{k d \cos\theta}{2} \right),
\qquad
|H_{\text{bip}}| = 2 \left| \sin\!\left( \frac{k d \cos\theta}{2} \right) \right|
$$

**Far-field decay at distance R** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-farfield))

$$
\phi_{\text{monopole}} \propto \frac{1}{R},\quad V_{\text{bip}} \propto \frac{d}{R^2};
\qquad
\phi_{\text{dipole}} \propto \frac{1}{R^2},\quad V_{\text{bip}} \propto \frac{d}{R^3}
$$

**Electric field from a clique (least squares)** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-clique-field))

$$
\hat{\mathbf E}(t) = -\left( D D^{\mathsf T} \right)^{-1} D\, \mathbf b(t)
$$

**Omnipolar signal** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-omnipole))

$$
v_\omega(t) = -d\, \hat\omega \cdot \hat{\mathbf E}(t)
$$

**Conduction velocity from one clique** ([derivation](../modules/m03-electrograms.qmd#eq-m03-clique-velocity))

$$
c \approx \frac{\mathrm{pp}\left( dU/dt \right)}{\mathrm{pp}\left( \hat n \cdot \hat{\mathbf E} \right)}
$$

## m37 · AI on the surface ECG

Symbols: $z_c$ class score, $p_c$ probability, $y_c$ label, $w[k]$ kernel weight, $f_s$ sampling rate, $k_l$ and $s_l$
kernel width and stride of layer $l$, $RR_i$ an RR interval, $\pi$ prevalence, Se and Sp sensitivity and specificity.
Model: a classifier that outputs class probabilities; the prior-shift result needs calibrated probabilities and
unchanged class-conditional recordings.

**Softmax** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-softmax))

$$
p_c = \frac{e^{z_c}}{\sum_{j=1}^{C} e^{z_j}}
$$

**Cross-entropy gradient** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-ce-grad))

$$
\frac{\partial L}{\partial z_c} = p_c - y_c
$$

**Logistic regression** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-logistic))

$$
p = \sigma(\beta_0 + \boldsymbol\beta^{\mathsf T}\mathbf x), \qquad \sigma(u) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-u}}
$$

**Convolution layer** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-conv))

$$
y[n] = b + \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} w[k]\, x[s n + k]
$$

**Kernel frequency response** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-kernel-response))

$$
H(f) = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} w[k]\, e^{-i 2\pi f k / f_s}
$$

**Receptive field** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-receptive-field))

$$
r = 1 + \sum_{l=1}^{L} (k_l - 1) \prod_{j<l} s_j
$$

**RR-interval features** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-rr))

$$
\overline{RR}, \qquad
\mathrm{CV} = \frac{s_{RR}}{\overline{RR}}, \qquad
\mathrm{nRMSSD} = \frac{1}{\overline{RR}} \sqrt{\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n-1} \left(RR_{i+1} - RR_i\right)^2 }
$$

**Screening yield** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-yield))

$$
N_{+} = N\left[\pi\,\mathrm{Se} + (1-\pi)(1-\mathrm{Sp})\right], \qquad
\frac{N_{+}}{N\pi\,\mathrm{Se}} = \frac{1}{\mathrm{PPV}}
$$

**Prior-shift correction** ([derivation](../modules/m37-ai-ecg.qmd#eq-m37-prior-shift))

$$
p' = \frac{\dfrac{\pi'}{\pi}\, p}{\dfrac{\pi'}{\pi}\, p + \dfrac{1-\pi'}{1-\pi}\,(1-p)}
$$

## m38 · Wearables and implantable monitors

Symbols: $RR_i$ beat intervals, $\Delta_i$ pulse delays, $\mathrm{IBI}_i$ pulse intervals, $q$ and $p$ per-window
flag rates in regular rhythm and AF, $k$ windows required in a row, $n$ windows per day, $L$ windows per episode,
$N$ patients, $\lambda$ alerts per patient per day, $\tau$ review minutes, $\kappa$ and $r$ shares of true alerts
kept and false alerts removed. Model: independent windows and alerts.

**Heart rate** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-hr))

$$
\mathrm{HR} = \frac{60}{\overline{\mathrm{IBI}}} \quad \text{beats per minute}
$$

**Pulse intervals** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-ibi))

$$
\mathrm{IBI}_i = RR_i + \left(\Delta_{i+1} - \Delta_i\right)
$$

**Pulse-interval variance** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-ibi-var))

$$
\operatorname{Var}(\mathrm{IBI}) = \operatorname{Var}(RR) + 2\sigma_\Delta^2\,(1 - \rho)
$$

**False notifications, k in a row** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-runs))

$$
\mathbb E[\text{runs}] = q^{k}\left[1 + (n - k)(1 - q)\right]
$$

**Episode caught** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-detect))

$$
a_m = \sum_{j=0}^{k-1} p^{j}(1 - p)\, a_{m-j-1}, \qquad P(\text{episode caught}) = 1 - a_L
$$

**Review load** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-workload))

$$
A = N\lambda, \qquad A_{\text{false}} = N\lambda\,(1 - \mathrm{PPV}), \qquad H = \frac{N\lambda\,\tau}{60}\ \text{hours}
$$

**PPV after a triage filter** ([derivation](../modules/m38-wearables-monitoring.qmd#eq-m38-filter))

$$
\mathrm{PPV}' = \frac{\kappa\,\mathrm{PPV}}{\kappa\,\mathrm{PPV} + (1 - r)(1 - \mathrm{PPV})}
$$

## m39 · AI on electrograms and maps

Symbols: $A$ mesh adjacency matrix, $I$ identity, $\tilde D$ degree matrix of $A + I$, $H$ vertex features, $W$ shared
weights, $\sigma$ nonlinearity, $\mathbf v$ eigenvector with $v_i \propto \sqrt{\tilde d_i}$, $P$ and $T$ predicted and true regions,
$R$ and $r$ disc radii, $d$ centre distance, $p_t$ probability of the true class, $\alpha$ and $\gamma$ focal-loss
weight and focusing parameters, $\pi_k$, $\mu_k$, $\sigma_k$ mixture weights, means and standard deviations, $\gamma_{ik}$
responsibilities.

**Graph convolution layer** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-gcn))

$$
H' = \sigma\!\left(\hat A H W\right), \qquad
\hat A = \tilde D^{-1/2}\,(A + I)\,\tilde D^{-1/2}
$$

**Fixed point of the normalized adjacency** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-smoothing))

$$
\hat A\, \mathbf v = \mathbf v, \qquad v_i \propto \sqrt{\tilde d_i}
$$

**Dice coefficient** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-dice))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} = \frac{2\,\lvert P \cap T \rvert}{\lvert P \rvert + \lvert T \rvert}
$$

**Overlap of two discs (lens area)** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-lens))

$$
\lvert P \cap T\rvert = r^2 \cos^{-1}\!\frac{d^2 + r^2 - R^2}{2dr} + R^2 \cos^{-1}\!\frac{d^2 + R^2 - r^2}{2dR}
- \tfrac12\sqrt{(-d + r + R)(d + r - R)(d - r + R)(d + r + R)}
$$

**Focal loss** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-focal))

$$
\mathrm{FL}(p_t) = -\alpha_t\,(1 - p_t)^{\gamma}\,\log p_t
$$

**Gaussian mixture responsibilities** ([derivation](../modules/m39-ai-electrograms-maps.qmd#eq-m39-gmm))

$$
\gamma_{ik} = \frac{\pi_k\, \mathcal N(x_i \mid \mu_k, \sigma_k)}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} \pi_j\, \mathcal N(x_i \mid \mu_j, \sigma_j)}
$$

## m40 · AI for cardiac imaging and substrate

Symbols: $P$ and $T$ predicted and true regions, $\partial P$ and $\partial T$ their surfaces, $J$ Jaccard index, $d(x, \partial T)$
distance from a point to a surface, $\tau$ tolerance, $\delta$ boundary offset, $S$ and $V$ surface area and volume, $R$
sphere radius, $t$ wall thickness, $t_i$, $e_i$ and $r_i$ follow-up time, event indicator and risk score of patient $i$.

**Dice and Jaccard** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-jaccard))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} = \frac{2J}{1 + J}, \qquad J = \frac{\mathrm{Dice}}{2 - \mathrm{Dice}}
$$

**Hausdorff distance** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-hausdorff))

$$
\mathrm{HD}(P, T) = \max\left\{ \max_{p \in \partial P} d(p, \partial T),\; \max_{q \in \partial T} d(q, \partial P) \right\}
$$

**Average symmetric surface distance** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-assd))

$$
\mathrm{ASSD} = \frac{\int_{\partial P} d(p, \partial T)\, dp + \int_{\partial T} d(q, \partial P)\, dq}{\lvert\partial P\rvert + \lvert\partial T\rvert}
$$

**Normalized surface Dice** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-nsd))

$$
\mathrm{NSD}_\tau = \frac{\lvert\{p \in \partial P : d(p, \partial T) \le \tau\}\rvert + \lvert\{q \in \partial T : d(q, \partial P) \le \tau\}\rvert}{\lvert\partial P\rvert + \lvert\partial T\rvert}
$$

**Dice after a uniform boundary offset** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-offset))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} \approx 1 - \frac{\lvert\delta\rvert\, S}{2V}
$$

**Concentric spheres** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-sphere))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} = \frac{2\min(R, R+\delta)^3}{R^3 + (R+\delta)^3} \approx 1 - \frac{3\lvert\delta\rvert}{2R}
$$

**Shifted wall** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-slab))

$$
\mathrm{Dice} = \max\!\left(0,\; 1 - \frac{\lvert\delta\rvert}{t}\right)
$$

**Harrell's concordance index** ([derivation](../modules/m40-ai-imaging-substrate.qmd#eq-m40-cindex))

$$
C = \frac{\sum_{i,j} \mathbb 1[t_i < t_j]\, e_i \left(\mathbb 1[r_i > r_j] + \tfrac12\, \mathbb 1[r_i = r_j]\right)}{\sum_{i,j} \mathbb 1[t_i < t_j]\, e_i}
$$

## m41 · Locating arrhythmia origins from the ECG

Symbols: $\Omega_{ej}$ solid angle of surface element $j$ seen from electrode $e$, $\tau_j$ activation times, $c$ potential scale,
$T$ integration window, $A = [X\;\mathbf 1]$ features with an intercept column, $R$ origin coordinates, $\mathbf u$, $\mathbf v$ unit vectors
on a sphere of radius $R$, $a_l$, $b_l$ two ECGs in lead $l$, $K$ and $\mathbf k_*$ kernel matrices, $\ell$, $\sigma_f$, $\sigma_n$ kernel length
scale, signal scale and noise, $f^*$ best score so far, $\xi$ margin, $\Phi$ and $\varphi$ standard normal distribution and density.

**QRS integral in a double-layer model** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-integral))

$$
x_e = \int_0^T \phi_e(t)\, dt = c \sum_j \Omega_{ej}\,(T - \tau_j)_+
= -c \sum_j \Omega_{ej}\, \tau_j \quad \text{when } T \ge \max_j \tau_j
$$

**Least-squares localization** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-linear))

$$
\begin{bmatrix} W \\ \mathbf b^\top \end{bmatrix} = (A^\top A)^{-1} A^\top R
$$

**Error along a spherical surface** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-geodesic))

$$
d = R \arccos(\mathbf u \cdot \mathbf v), \qquad \lvert \mathbf u - \mathbf v \rvert R = 2R\sin\frac{d}{2R} \le d
$$

**Pace-map similarity** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-corr))

$$
\rho = \frac{1}{12} \sum_{l=1}^{12} \frac{\sum_t (a_l(t) - \bar a_l)(b_l(t) - \bar b_l)}{\sqrt{\sum_t (a_l(t) - \bar a_l)^2 \sum_t (b_l(t) - \bar b_l)^2}}
$$

**Gaussian-process posterior** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-gp))

$$
\mu(\mathbf s) = m + \mathbf k_*^\top (K + \sigma_n^2 I)^{-1} (\mathbf f - m), \qquad
\sigma^2(\mathbf s) = \sigma_f^2 - \mathbf k_*^\top (K + \sigma_n^2 I)^{-1} \mathbf k_*
$$

**Expected improvement** ([derivation](../modules/m41-ai-origin-localization.qmd#eq-m41-ei))

$$
\mathrm{EI}(\mathbf s) = \Delta\, \Phi\!\left(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\right) + \sigma\, \varphi\!\left(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\right),
\qquad \Delta = \mu(\mathbf s) - f^* - \xi
$$

## m42 · Physics-informed machine learning

Symbols: $T$ activation time (ms), $s = 1/v$ slowness (ms/mm), $\mathbf x_i$, $t_i$ measurement points and times, $\mathbf x_c$
collocation points, $\lambda$ physics weight (ms²), $\mathbf c_k$, $h$, $a_k$ basis centres, width and coefficients, $J$ Jacobian,
$\mathbf r$ residual vector, $\mu$ damping, $T_m$ ensemble members, $k$ a scale factor.

**Eikonal residual** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-eikonal))

$$
r(\mathbf x) = s(\mathbf x)\,\lvert \nabla T(\mathbf x) \rvert - 1
$$

**Physics-informed loss** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-loss))

$$
L = \frac{1}{N_d} \sum_{i=1}^{N_d} \big(T(\mathbf x_i) - t_i\big)^2 + \frac{\lambda}{N_c} \sum_{c=1}^{N_c} r(\mathbf x_c)^2
$$

**Radial-basis map and its gradient** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-rbf))

$$
T(\mathbf x) = a_0 + \sum_{k} a_k\, e^{-\lvert \mathbf x - \mathbf c_k\rvert^2/2h^2}, \qquad
\nabla T(\mathbf x) = -\sum_k a_k\, \frac{\mathbf x - \mathbf c_k}{h^2}\, e^{-\lvert \mathbf x - \mathbf c_k\rvert^2/2h^2}
$$

**Levenberg–Marquardt step** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-lm))

$$
\left(J^\top J + \mu\, \mathrm{diag}(J^\top J)\right) \boldsymbol\delta = -J^\top \mathbf r, \qquad J = \frac{\partial \mathbf r}{\partial \mathbf p}
$$

**Ensemble mean and spread** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-ensemble))

$$
\bar T(\mathbf x) = \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M} T_m(\mathbf x), \qquad
\sigma^2(\mathbf x) = \frac{1}{M-1}\sum_{m=1}^{M} \big(T_m(\mathbf x) - \bar T(\mathbf x)\big)^2
$$

**Slowness scaling of activation times** ([derivation](../modules/m42-physics-informed-ml.qmd#eq-m42-scaling))

$$
T\big(\mathbf x;\, k\,s(\cdot)\big) = k\, T\big(\mathbf x;\, s(\cdot)\big)
$$

## m43 · Foundation models and large language models

Symbols: $N$ batch size, $S_{ik}$ similarity of anchor $i$ and candidate $k$ (unit embeddings), $\tau$ temperature, $P_{ik}$ row softmax of $S/\tau$, $Q, K, V$ queries, keys and values, $d$ key length, $\operatorname{tf}$ term count in a document, $\operatorname{df}$ number of documents containing the term, $\hat p = k/n$ observed accuracy, $z$ normal quantile (1.96 for 95%), $h$ interval half-width.
Model: independent questions for the intervals; independent unit-variance query and key entries for the scaling.

**InfoNCE contrastive loss** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-infonce))

$$
L = -\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} \ln \frac{\exp(S_{ii}/\tau)}{\sum_{k=1}^{N} \exp(S_{ik}/\tau)}
$$

**Its gradient with respect to the similarities** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-infonce-grad))

$$
\frac{\partial L}{\partial S_{ik}} = \frac{P_{ik} - \delta_{ik}}{N\tau}
$$

**Scaled dot-product attention** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-attention))

$$
\operatorname{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt d}\right) V
$$

**Variance of a query-key score** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-scaling))

$$
\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbf q^\top \mathbf k\right) = d, \qquad
\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\mathbf q^\top \mathbf k / \sqrt d\right) = 1
$$

**TF-IDF weight (smoothed)** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-tfidf))

$$
w_{t,d} = \operatorname{tf}_{t,d}\left[\ln\frac{1 + N}{1 + \operatorname{df}_t} + 1\right]
$$

**Cosine similarity** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-cosine))

$$
\cos(\mathbf a, \mathbf b) = \frac{\mathbf a^\top \mathbf b}{\lVert\mathbf a\rVert\,\lVert\mathbf b\rVert}
$$

**Wilson score interval** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-wilson))

$$
\frac{\hat p + \dfrac{z^2}{2n} \pm z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat p(1-\hat p)}{n} + \dfrac{z^2}{4n^2}}}{1 + \dfrac{z^2}{n}}
$$

**Questions needed for an interval of half-width h** ([derivation](../modules/m43-foundation-models-llms.qmd#eq-m43-questions))

$$
n \approx \frac{z^2\,p(1-p)}{h^2}
$$

## m44 · Agentic AI in EP

Symbols: $n$ steps in a task, $p_i$ or $p$ step success, $c$ share of failed steps a check catches, $p_r$ success of the retry, $N$ tasks, $r$ share of wrong outputs a reviewer catches, $h$ share of hard tasks, $p_e$, $p_h$ step success in easy and hard tasks, $\bar p$ mean step success.
Model: steps fail independently (except in the mixture), one retry per caught failure.

**Task success of a chain of independent steps** ([derivation](../modules/m44-agentic-ai.qmd#eq-m44-chain))

$$
P_{\text{task}} = \prod_{i=1}^{n} p_i \;=\; p^n \ \text{ if all } p_i = p
$$

**With a check and one retry** ([derivation](../modules/m44-agentic-ai.qmd#eq-m44-check))

$$
P_{\text{task}} = \big[\,p + (1-p)\,c\,p_r\,\big]^n \;=\; \big[1 - (1-p)(1-c)\big]^n \ \text{ if } p_r = 1
$$

**Wrong outputs that get past a reviewer** ([derivation](../modules/m44-agentic-ai.qmd#eq-m44-escape))

$$
E = N\,(1 - P_{\text{task}})\,(1 - r)
$$

**Correlated errors: hard and easy tasks** ([derivation](../modules/m44-agentic-ai.qmd#eq-m44-mixture))

$$
P_{\text{task}} = (1-h)\,p_e^{\,n} + h\,p_h^{\,n} \;\ge\; \bar p^{\,n}, \qquad \bar p = (1-h)\,p_e + h\,p_h
$$

## m45 · Evidence and regulation of AI in EP

Symbols: $Se$, $Sp$ expected sensitivity and specificity, $d$ interval half-width, $\pi$ prevalence, $z$ normal quantile (1.96 for 95%), TP and FP true and false positives among $n$ patients, $p_t$ threshold probability, $x_t$ standardized daily statistic, $\mu_0$ its in-control mean, $k$ allowance, $h$ alarm threshold.
Model: independent patients and days; normal approximation for the sample size.

**Patients needed for a sensitivity or specificity interval** ([derivation](../modules/m45-ai-evidence-regulation.qmd#eq-m45-n-sens))

$$
n_{Se} = \frac{z^2\,Se\,(1-Se)}{d^2\,\pi}, \qquad n_{Sp} = \frac{z^2\,Sp\,(1-Sp)}{d^2\,(1-\pi)}
$$

**Net benefit of a decision rule** ([derivation](../modules/m45-ai-evidence-regulation.qmd#eq-m45-net-benefit))

$$
\mathrm{NB}(p_t) = \frac{\mathrm{TP}}{n} - \frac{\mathrm{FP}}{n}\cdot\frac{p_t}{1 - p_t}
$$

**CUSUM drift alarm** ([derivation](../modules/m45-ai-evidence-regulation.qmd#eq-m45-cusum))

$$
S_t = \max\bigl(0,\; S_{t-1} + x_t - \mu_0 - k\bigr), \quad S_0 = 0, \qquad \text{alarm when } S_t > h
$$

## m46 · Trustworthy AI in EP

Symbols: $F$ model output, $\mathbf x$ input, $\mathbf x'$ baseline, $\hat p_k$ predicted probability of class $k$, $n$ calibration examples, $\alpha$ error rate, $\hat q$ conformal threshold, $\pi$ prevalence, TPR, FPR, PPV true-positive rate, false-positive rate and positive predictive value, $\mathbf f$ features with training mean $\boldsymbol\mu$ and covariance $\Sigma$, $k$ number of features, $L$ loss, $\varepsilon$ max-norm change, $z = \mathbf w^\top\mathbf x + b$ linear score.
Model: exchangeable calibration and test data for the conformal guarantee; Gaussian features for the chi-square reference.

**Integrated gradients and completeness** ([derivation](../modules/m46-trustworthy-ai.qmd#eq-m46-ig))

$$
\mathrm{IG}_i(\mathbf x) = (x_i - x'_i)\int_0^1 \frac{\partial F\bigl(\mathbf x' + \alpha(\mathbf x - \mathbf x')\bigr)}{\partial x_i}\,d\alpha,
\qquad \sum_i \mathrm{IG}_i(\mathbf x) = F(\mathbf x) - F(\mathbf x')
$$

**Split conformal prediction sets** ([derivation](../modules/m46-trustworthy-ai.qmd#eq-m46-conformal))

$$
\hat q = s_{(\lceil (n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil)}, \qquad
C(\mathbf x) = \{k : 1 - \hat p_k(\mathbf x) \le \hat q\}, \qquad
\Pr\bigl(y \in C(\mathbf x)\bigr) \ge 1 - \alpha
$$

**False-positive rate from prevalence, PPV and TPR** ([derivation](../modules/m46-trustworthy-ai.qmd#eq-m46-fpr))

$$
\mathrm{FPR} = \frac{\pi}{1-\pi}\cdot\frac{1-\mathrm{PPV}}{\mathrm{PPV}}\cdot\mathrm{TPR}
$$

**Mahalanobis unfamiliarity score** ([derivation](../modules/m46-trustworthy-ai.qmd#eq-m46-mahalanobis))

$$
d^2(\mathbf x) = \bigl(\mathbf f(\mathbf x) - \boldsymbol\mu\bigr)^{\top}\Sigma^{-1}\bigl(\mathbf f(\mathbf x) - \boldsymbol\mu\bigr) \;\sim\; \chi^2_k \ \text{ for Gaussian features}
$$

**Fast gradient sign attack on a linear score** ([derivation](../modules/m46-trustworthy-ai.qmd#eq-m46-fgsm))

$$
\mathbf x_{\text{adv}} = \mathbf x + \varepsilon\,\operatorname{sign}\bigl(\nabla_{\mathbf x} L\bigr), \qquad
\lvert\Delta z\rvert \le \varepsilon\lVert\mathbf w\rVert_1, \qquad
\varepsilon^\ast = \frac{\lvert z\rvert}{\lVert\mathbf w\rVert_1}
$$

## m47 · Data and deployment engineering

Symbols: $d$ stored integer (adu), $b$ baseline (adu), $g$ gain (adu per physical unit), $v$ physical value, $m$ labellers each right with probability $p$, $f_i$ size of record $i$'s equivalence class, $k$ smallest class size, $J$ number of classes, $n$ records, $r$ real value, $q$ integer, $S$ scale, $Z$ zero point, $b$ bits (in the SQNR), $\overline{x^2}$ mean square of the signal.
Model: independent labellers; an attacker who knows the person is in the data; rounding error uniform within one step.

**Header conversion** ([derivation](../modules/m47-data-deployment-engineering.qmd#eq-m47-adu))

$$
v = \frac{d - b}{g}, \qquad \lvert v_{\text{stored}} - v \rvert \le \frac{1}{2g}
$$

**Majority of labellers** ([derivation](../modules/m47-data-deployment-engineering.qmd#eq-m47-majority))

$$
P_{\text{maj}}(m, p) = \sum_{j=(m+1)/2}^{m} \binom{m}{j}\, p^{j} (1 - p)^{m-j}
$$

**Re-identification risk** ([derivation](../modules/m47-data-deployment-engineering.qmd#eq-m47-risk))

$$
r_i = \frac{1}{f_i}, \qquad R_{\max} = \frac{1}{\min_i f_i} = \frac{1}{k}, \qquad
\bar R = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{f_i} = \frac{J}{n}
$$

**Affine integer quantization** ([derivation](../modules/m47-data-deployment-engineering.qmd#eq-m47-affine))

$$
r = S\,(q - Z), \qquad S = \frac{r_{\max} - r_{\min}}{q_{\max} - q_{\min}}, \qquad
Z = q_{\min} - \operatorname{round}\!\left(\frac{r_{\min}}{S}\right)
$$

**Quantization noise and SQNR** ([derivation](../modules/m47-data-deployment-engineering.qmd#eq-m47-qnoise))

$$
\sigma_e^2 = \frac{S^2}{12}, \qquad
\mathrm{SQNR} = 10 \log_{10} \frac{\overline{x^2}}{S^2/12}\ \text{dB} \;\approx\; 6.02\,b + 1.76\ \text{dB for a full-scale sine}
$$

## m49 · Fluoroscopy and radiation protection

Symbols: $I_0$ incident and $I$ transmitted intensity, $\mu$ linear attenuation coefficient (1/mm), HVL half-value layer, $C$ subject contrast of an object of thickness $t$ with attenuation $\mu_o$ in background $\mu_b$, $N$ photons per pixel, CNR contrast-to-noise ratio, $K$ air kerma, $A$ beam area, $d$ distance from the focal spot, $P_{KA}$ kerma-area product, $H$ staff dose, $f_p$ pulse rate, $q$ dose per pulse, $\tau$ time, $r$ distance from the patient, $n$ shielding in half-value layers.
Model: narrow monoenergetic beam; Poisson photon counts; scatter from a point at the patient.

**Attenuation and half-value layer** ([derivation](../modules/m49-fluoroscopy-radiation.qmd#eq-m49-beer))

$$
I = I_0 \exp\!\left(-\int \mu(s)\, ds\right), \qquad \mathrm{HVL} = \frac{\ln 2}{\mu}
$$

**Subject contrast** ([derivation](../modules/m49-fluoroscopy-radiation.qmd#eq-m49-contrast))

$$
C = 1 - e^{-(\mu_o - \mu_b)\, t} \;\approx\; (\mu_o - \mu_b)\, t \ \text{ when small}
$$

**Quantum noise** ([derivation](../modules/m49-fluoroscopy-radiation.qmd#eq-m49-cnr))

$$
\mathrm{CNR} = \frac{N_b - N_o}{\sqrt{N_b}} = C\sqrt{N}, \qquad N_{\text{needed}} = \left(\frac{\mathrm{CNR}^\ast}{C}\right)^2
$$

**Kerma-area product along the beam** ([derivation](../modules/m49-fluoroscopy-radiation.qmd#eq-m49-kap))

$$
K(d) = K(d_0)\left(\frac{d_0}{d}\right)^2, \qquad A(d) = A(d_0)\left(\frac{d}{d_0}\right)^2
\;\Rightarrow\; P_{KA} = K\,A \ \text{ is the same at every } d
$$

**Staff dose: time, distance, shielding** ([derivation](../modules/m49-fluoroscopy-radiation.qmd#eq-m49-staff))

$$
H \;\propto\; \frac{f_p\, q\, \tau}{r^2}\; 2^{-n}
$$

## m50 · Intracardiac echocardiography

Symbols: $t$ echo round-trip time, $c$ speed of sound ($c_{\text{assumed}}$ used by the scanner, $c_{\text{true}}$ in the tissue), $z$ depth, $\hat z$ displayed depth, $f$ frequency, $\lambda$ wavelength, $n$ cycles per pulse, $\alpha$ attenuation slope in dB/(cm·MHz), $B$ signal budget in dB, $N$ elements spaced $d$ apart at positions $x_k$, $\theta_0$ steering angle, $D$ image depth, $N_{\text{lines}}$ lines per frame.
Model: straight-line propagation at one speed of sound; attenuation linear in frequency; far-field array factor of point elements.

**Echo time to depth** ([derivation](../modules/m50-intracardiac-echo.qmd#eq-m50-range))

$$
z = \frac{c\,t}{2}, \qquad \hat z = z\,\frac{c_{\text{assumed}}}{c_{\text{true}}}
$$

**Axial resolution** ([derivation](../modules/m50-intracardiac-echo.qmd#eq-m50-axial))

$$
\lambda = \frac{c}{f}, \qquad \Delta z_{\text{axial}} = \frac{n\,\lambda}{2}
$$

**Attenuation and reach** ([derivation](../modules/m50-intracardiac-echo.qmd#eq-m50-attenuation))

$$
L = 2\,\alpha\,f\,z \ \text{dB}, \qquad z_{\max} = \frac{B}{2\,\alpha\,f}
$$

**Phased-array steering and grating lobes** ([derivation](../modules/m50-intracardiac-echo.qmd#eq-m50-steer))

$$
\tau_k = \frac{x_k \sin\theta_0}{c}, \qquad
\mathrm{AF}(\theta) = \frac{1}{N}\left|\sum_{k=0}^{N-1} e^{\,i 2\pi k \frac{d}{\lambda}(\sin\theta - \sin\theta_0)}\right|, \qquad
\sin\theta_m = \sin\theta_0 + m\frac{\lambda}{d}
$$

**Frame rate** ([derivation](../modules/m50-intracardiac-echo.qmd#eq-m50-frame-rate))

$$
\mathrm{FR} = \frac{c}{2\,D\,N_{\text{lines}}}
$$

## m51 · Cardiac CT

Symbols: $\mu$ linear attenuation coefficient ($\mu_w$ water, $\mu_a$ air), $c$ iodine concentration in mg/mL, $(\mu/\rho)_{\mathrm I}$ iodine mass attenuation, $f(x,y)$ image, $p_\theta(s)$ projection at angle $\theta$ and offset $s$, $P_\theta(k)$ its 1-D Fourier transform, $F$ the image's 2-D Fourier transform, $q_\theta$ filtered projection, $d$ detector spacing, $N_0$ photons per ray, $T_{\text{rot}}$ rotation time, $N_{\text{src}}$ X-ray sources, $v$ speed, $b$ blur, $D$ vessel diameter, $w$ wall thickness, $\sigma$ blur standard deviation.
Model: monoenergetic beam; parallel-beam geometry; Poisson counts; constant speed during the window; Gaussian blur.

**Hounsfield units** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-hu))

$$
\mathrm{HU} = 1000\,\frac{\mu - \mu_w}{\mu_w - \mu_a}
$$

**Iodine contrast** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-iodine))

$$
\Delta\mathrm{HU} = 1000\,\frac{c \cdot 10^{-3}\,(\mu/\rho)_{\mathrm I}}{\mu_w}
$$

**Projection (Radon transform)** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-radon))

$$
p_\theta(s) = \iint f(x, y)\,\delta(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta - s)\,dx\,dy
$$

**Central-slice theorem** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-slice))

$$
P_\theta(k) = \int p_\theta(s)\,e^{-i2\pi k s}\,ds = \iint f(x, y)\,e^{-i2\pi k (x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)}\,dx\,dy = F(k\cos\theta,\,k\sin\theta)
$$

**Filtered back-projection** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-fbp))

$$
f(x, y) = \int_0^{\pi} q_\theta(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)\,d\theta, \qquad
q_\theta = \mathcal{F}^{-1}\{\,|k|\,P_\theta(k)\,\}
$$

**Ram-Lak kernel** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-ramlak))

$$
h[0] = \frac{1}{4d^2}, \qquad h[n] = -\frac{1}{\pi^2 n^2 d^2}\ \ (n \text{ odd}), \qquad h[n] = 0\ \ (n \text{ even},\ n \neq 0)
$$

**Quantum noise** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-noise))

$$
\operatorname{Var}\!\left[-\ln\frac{N}{N_0}\right] \approx \frac{1}{\bar N} = \frac{e^{p}}{N_0}
$$

**Gating window and motion blur** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-gating))

$$
\Delta t \approx \frac{T_{\text{rot}}}{2\,N_{\text{src}}}, \qquad b = v\,\Delta t
$$

**A smeared disk** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-smear))

$$
I(x, y) = \frac{\left|\,[x - b/2,\ x + b/2] \cap [-c,\ c]\,\right|}{b}, \qquad c = \sqrt{D^2/4 - y^2}
$$

**A blurred thin wall** ([derivation](../modules/m51-cardiac-ct.qmd#eq-m51-wall))

$$
g(x) = \tfrac12\left[\operatorname{erf}\!\left(\frac{x + w/2}{\sqrt2\,\sigma}\right) - \operatorname{erf}\!\left(\frac{x - w/2}{\sqrt2\,\sigma}\right)\right], \qquad
g(0) = \operatorname{erf}\!\left(\frac{w}{2\sqrt2\,\sigma}\right)
$$

## m52 · Cardiac MRI

Symbols: $\gamma$ gyromagnetic ratio, $B_0$ static field, $f$ Larmor frequency, $M_z$ longitudinal magnetization ($M_0$ at equilibrium), $T_1$ longitudinal relaxation time ($T_{1m}$ myocardium, $T_{1s}$ scar, $T_{1,0}$ native), $r_1$ relaxivity, $[\mathrm{Gd}]$ concentration, $R_1 = 1/T_1$, ECV extracellular volume fraction, Hct hematocrit, TI inversion time, $I$ image intensity, $\theta$ threshold, $B$ burden.
Model: ideal inversion; readout ignored; gadolinium at equilibrium between blood and extracellular space.

**Larmor relation** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-larmor))

$$
f = \frac{\gamma}{2\pi}\,B_0
$$

**Inversion recovery** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-ir))

$$
M_z(t) = M_0\left(1 - 2e^{-t/T_1}\right), \qquad M_z = 0 \ \text{at}\ t = T_1 \ln 2
$$

**Relaxivity** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-relaxivity))

$$
\frac{1}{T_1} = \frac{1}{T_{1,0}} + r_1\,[\mathrm{Gd}]
$$

**Extracellular volume** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-ecv))

$$
\mathrm{ECV} = (1 - \mathrm{Hct})\,\frac{\Delta R_{1,\text{myo}}}{\Delta R_{1,\text{blood}}}
$$

**Inversion time for LGE** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-lge))

$$
\mathrm{TI}^* = \frac{\ln(T_{1m}/T_{1s})}{1/T_{1s} - 1/T_{1m}}
$$

**Image intensity ratio and burden** ([derivation](../modules/m52-cardiac-mri.qmd#eq-m52-iir))

$$
\mathrm{IIR}_i = \frac{I_{\text{wall},i}}{\bar I_{\text{blood}}}, \qquad
B(\theta) = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} \mathbf{1}\!\left[\mathrm{IIR}_i > \theta\right]
$$
